title: Billing & Licenses

modal.issue_desc: Generate a new cryptographic license with custom hardware quotas and feature entitlements.
modal.extend_desc: Add active subscription months to the selected tenant license.

modal.export_desc: Signed cryptographic file for air-gapped on-premise installation without internet access.

feedback.issue_success: License key successfully generated and activated.
